question.text: An LVF Cat III AIF can invest up to what percentage of its investable funds in one investee company?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI (AIF) Third Amendment Regulations 2021, LVFs of Cat III can invest up to 20% of investable funds in one investee company. The Trap: 10% is the standard Cat III limit; 25% does not apply. Cross-Exam Context: Same higher LVF threshold applies in XIX-A for Cat I/II. Distributor's Pro-Tip: The extra 10 percentage points is a big concentration allowance — ensure governance oversight is commensurate.
